answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 162080 Country: india Title: Wazifah for job Question: I want to become an IES officer from the past two years I am trying hard at least to qualify, I am not getting qualified .i am giving my effort 100% but I am not up to the mark. I do pray daily 3 times and in the morning I read surah Baqarah. Please show me the way. Answer ID: 162080 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1269/1046/L=9/1439) Pray five times salah regularly and supplicate Allah wholeheartedly, in-shaAllah, you shall achieve your goal.
